text:
Zara Ahmed: hey all! excited to join the product analytics team today. i'm hybrid (bay area) and usually in on mondays/wednesdays. i collect weird board games and would love to know if theres still a monthly game night? also bad news: my gf says my snack drawer is a hazard zone. any snack gatekeepers i should ping? :board_game:
WelcomeBot: welcome to Redwood, Zara! :wave: Check the socials calendar for recurring events. You'll also get a new-hire slack lunch invite.
Ben K: welcome!! we do a casual game night on the last friday of the month in the lounge. bring a 2p-6p game and you'll be a hero. :tophat:
Laila: hey Zara, welcome!! i run the game stash — there's a shelf with some classics plus a handwritten list. i can save you a spot for the next one. (ps we have a strict chips-only policy near the keyboards)
Zara Ahmed: chips-only policy noted. will not bring salsa near the server rack. whats the vibe competitive or chill? i own a weird party deduction game and a tiny cooperative one for two.
Arlo: very chill. usually 6-9pm, people cycle in/out. bring friends. we also do a 15-minute "teach" slot at the start of the night if it's a new game.
Priya: also: snack etiquette = label things you want to claim. fridge is communal but marked lunches are sacred. 
Ben K: if you want, drop a photo of the game's box here and i'll add it to the Slack event so folks know what's coming.
Zara Ahmed: will do! also quick logistics q: where's a safe place to stash a small box of cards? don't want them to become inter-office confetti.
Laila: there's a lockable cubby in the lounge by the beanbag. i'll leave a sticky note for you.
Zara Ahmed: amazing. thanks y'all super pumped to be here and to bring a few spoilers for game night. see you monday. :party_popper:
Ben K: welcome again! ping me for onboarding coffee, i'll bring the terrible puns.
Priya: welcome welcome. fyi there's a "snack run" channel if you ever need emergency pretzels. 
Zara Ahmed: perfect. i'll sign up for the new-hire lunch and grab some pretzels as a peace offering. :)
